name: context7
description: Up-to-date library and framework documentation lookup. Pass a dashboard API key as Authorization: Bearer, or use https://mcp.context7.com/mcp/oauth for browser sign-in without this header

name: openaiDeveloperDocs
description: Official read-only OpenAI documentation server for searching and reading developer docs and API specifications

name: openrouter
description: Official OpenRouter MCP server for live model catalog, pricing, credits, rankings, documentation, and test inference

name: github
description: Official GitHub MCP server for repositories, issues, pull requests, and workflows

name: cloudflare-api
description: Official Code Mode MCP server for the complete Cloudflare API

name: gmail
description: Official Gmail remote MCP server for searching threads, reading email, creating drafts, and managing labels

name: google-calendar
description: Official Google Calendar remote MCP server for events, calendars, scheduling, and availability

name: gcloud
description: Google-maintained MCP server for interacting with Google Cloud through the gcloud CLI

name: vercel
description: Official Vercel MCP server for projects, deployments, logs, and documentation

name: figma
description: Official Figma MCP server for design context, components, variables, and canvas workflows

name: slack
description: Official Slack MCP server for search, messages, channels, canvases, and workspace users

name: stripe
description: Official Stripe MCP server for payments, customers, subscriptions, and documentation

name: chrome-devtools
description: Official Chrome DevTools MCP server for browser debugging, automation, and performance analysis

name: everything-test
description: Official MCP reference server for testing client support across tools, resources, prompts, sampling, and other protocol features

name: supabase
description: Connects AI assistants to a Supabase project (database, edge functions, and more)

name: luma
description: Luma MCP —— 接入自定义视觉模型 provider（图像/视觉任务）

name: tinyfish
description: Official TinyFish MCP server for web search, content extraction, multi-step web automation, and remote browser sessions

name: exa
description: Official Exa MCP server for advanced web search and AI research

name: tavily
description: Official Tavily MCP server for web search, extraction, mapping, crawling, and research

name: brave-search
description: Official Brave Search MCP server for web, news, image, video, local, and AI-powered search

name: perplexity
description: Official Perplexity MCP server for AI search, cited answers, and deep research

name: serper
description: Community Serper MCP server for Google web search results

name: serpapi
description: Official SerpApi MCP server for structured search engine results

name: kagi
description: Official Kagi MCP server for privacy-focused web search and content extraction

name: jina
description: Official Jina AI remote MCP server for web search, extraction, reading, and research

name: you
description: Official You.com remote MCP server for keyless web search; the free profile allows only you-search and you-discover, 100 queries per day, with no signup, API key, or card

name: firecrawl
description: Web scraping, crawling, and search via the Firecrawl API (remote http)

name: firecrawl
description: Official Firecrawl MCP server for web search, scraping, extraction, mapping, crawling, and research

name: serena
description: Official Serena MCP server for semantic code retrieval and editing. Install with uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent, run serena init, and keep serena on the Agent PATH. This global template uses the desktop-app context; activate a project in the client. Marketplace install commands and the local HTTP mode are not used

name: playwright
description: Official Playwright MCP server for browser automation through accessibility snapshots. Requires Node.js 20 or newer. The published standard config has no API key; the first run can download a browser

name: microsoft-learn
description: Official remote Microsoft Learn MCP server for documentation, articles, and code samples. Streamable HTTP with no authentication and no charge. The endpoint is for MCP clients and can return HTTP 405 in a browser

name: qdrant
description: Official open-source Qdrant MCP server for semantic memory in a Qdrant collection. Stdio only: this MCP server has no authentication, so its SSE and streamable HTTP modes are not cataloged. Uses local Qdrant at http://localhost:6333 and collection my-collection, which the server creates if missing. For Qdrant Cloud, replace QDRANT_URL and add QDRANT_API_KEY; do not also set QDRANT_LOCAL_PATH. Embeddings use FastEmbed and need no provider key

name: mem0
description: Official hosted Mem0 MCP server for account-backed memory tools. Browser OAuth is the default, so no API key header is set. Headless clients can instead send a dashboard API key as an Authorization bearer. A missing sign-in returns 401

name: reference-memory
description: Reference implementation of a local knowledge-graph memory server from modelcontextprotocol/servers, published as @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory. It is not a hosted memory product. Requires Node.js 24 or newer when launched with npx. Set MEMORY_FILE_PATH to an absolute file you own; the default file lives in the npx package directory and can disappear when that cache is cleared. The loopback HTTP mode is not included

name: dbhub
description: Official DBHub stdio MCP server for Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, ClickHouse, and SQLite. Requires Node.js 22.5 or newer. Set DSN to your connection string and use a least-privilege read-only database user; this template does not enable DBHub readonly mode. The HTTP transport is omitted because it listens on every interface with authentication off unless DBHUB_AUTH_TOKEN is set

name: notion
description: Official remote Notion MCP server over Streamable HTTP. Complete the workspace OAuth flow. The legacy SSE endpoint and the unmaintained self-hosted package are not used. An admin policy can block the connection. Business and Enterprise workspaces can use an MCP token as a bearer instead of interactive OAuth

name: atlassian-rovo
description: Official Atlassian Rovo remote MCP server for Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Jira Service Management, and Loom. OAuth 2.1 is the recommended sign-in, so no Authorization header is set. API tokens are an admin-enabled alternative and are not included. Organization domain and IP rules can block the connection

name: supabase
description: Official hosted Supabase MCP server. OAuth is required. Supabase documents security risks for connecting an assistant; optional query parameters are read_only=true and project_ref. This HTTP entry is separate from the community supabase stdio package

name: linear
description: Official Linear MCP server for issues, projects, and documents. Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1. Read-only access is the separate /mcp/readonly URL, not this template.

name: sentry
description: Official hosted Sentry MCP server. OAuth. Scope it to one organization or project by appending those slugs to the path. Self-hosted Sentry uses the sentry CLI instead of this URL.

name: datadog
description: Official Datadog MCP server for the US1 site. OAuth. Other sites use the matching host from the Datadog setup table, such as mcp.datadoghq.eu or mcp.us3.datadoghq.com. Gov sites are unsupported.

name: grafana
description: Official open-source Grafana MCP server. Requires Grafana 9.0 or later. Set GRAFANA_URL to your instance and GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN to a service-account token. Grafana Cloud also offers a separate hosted OAuth server.

name: gitlab
description: Official GitLab.com MCP server. OAuth with dynamic client registration, or a fine-grained personal access token with the mcp scope. A top-level group must allow the MCP server. Self-managed instances use the same /api/v4/mcp path on their own host.

name: redis
description: Official Redis MCP server for a Redis instance you run. This template points at redis://localhost:6379/0 with no password. Replace the URL for Redis Cloud or authenticated servers. Do not put a password in the arguments.

name: terraform
description: Official HashiCorp Terraform MCP server, local stdio via Docker, for current provider and module docs. HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise tools need TFE_TOKEN and TFE_ADDRESS, which this template does not set. The hosted endpoint is https://mcp.terraform.io/mcp.

name: mongodb
description: Official MongoDB MCP server in read-only mode. Run npx mongodb-mcp-server@latest setup or set the connection string in the client before use. Read-only is the catalog default.

name: prisma
description: Official hosted Prisma Postgres MCP server. Streamable HTTP with OAuth to the Prisma Console.

name: neon
description: Official hosted Neon MCP server. OAuth. A Neon account is required. The documented category query string is optional and is not included.

name: wordpress-com
description: Official WordPress.com MCP server. OAuth 2.1. Enable MCP on the account. Paid plans include it; free sites are documented as included through 2026-11-30. Jetpack-connected sites use this same server.

name: zapier
description: Official Zapier MCP server. OAuth on the supported-client path. Zapier creates the default server during sign-in. Connection tokens are an alternative for unlisted clients and are not stored here.

name: aws-knowledge
description: Official AWS Knowledge remote MCP server. Fully managed and documented without an API key in the client config. This is not the local awslabs specialized-server suite.

name: posthog
description: Official PostHog MCP server. OAuth. The authentication server routes the account to its US or EU region.

name: canva
description: Official Canva CLI MCP launcher. Requires Node.js. The CLI completes Canva account authorization. This is not a pasted client id or client secret.

name: webflow
description: Official Webflow MCP server. OAuth. EU workspaces use https://mcp.eu.webflow.com/mcp instead. Site role Reviewer cannot connect.

name: asana
description: Official Asana MCP server, v2 Streamable HTTP. OAuth. The legacy SSE URL is not used.

name: honeycomb
description: Official Honeycomb MCP server for the US region. OAuth. EU accounts use https://mcp.eu1.honeycomb.io/mcp.

name: pagerduty
description: Official hosted PagerDuty MCP server. OAuth. EU accounts use https://mcp.eu.pagerduty.com/mcp.

name: huggingface
description: Official Hugging Face MCP server. Use browser sign-in, or add an Authorization bearer with a Hugging Face token. This template does not store a token. Tool and Space access is configured at huggingface.co/settings/mcp.

name: pulumi
description: Official Pulumi MCP server. OAuth to a Pulumi account.

name: azure
description: Official Azure MCP server. Requires Azure sign-in through the Azure CLI or the server's own login. No secret is stored in the template.

name: shopify-dev
description: Official Shopify Dev MCP server for app development. Requires Node.js. Distinct from the per-shop Storefront MCP, which has no single hostname.

name: salesforce
description: Official Salesforce DX MCP server. Authorize an org with the Salesforce CLI before use. This template does not enable non-GA tools. Toolsets are orgs, metadata, data, and users.

name: docker-mcp-gateway
description: Official Docker MCP gateway in default stdio mode. Requires Docker Desktop or the docker mcp CLI. The streaming mode that binds a port is not used.

name: clickhouse
description: Official ClickHouse MCP server via uv. Set CLICKHOUSE_HOST, CLICKHOUSE_USER, and CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD for your server. TLS verification stays on. Do not disable auth or publish the server.

name: amplitude
description: Official Amplitude organization MCP server for the US region. OAuth or a service account. EU accounts use https://mcp.eu.amplitude.com/mcp. The public docs MCP is a different server and is not included.

name: clickup
description: Official ClickUp MCP server. OAuth. Actions stay inside the signed-in user's ClickUp permissions.

name: mixpanel
description: Official Mixpanel MCP server for the US region. OAuth. EU and India use mcp-eu.mixpanel.com and mcp-in.mixpanel.com.

name: newrelic
description: Official New Relic MCP server for the US region. OAuth. EU and JP accounts replace this URL with the regional endpoint from the New Relic setup page.

name: descope
description: Official Descope MCP server for the US deployment. OAuth. Other regions use the hosts listed in the Descope docs, such as mcp.euc1.descope.com.

name: shortcut
description: Official Shortcut MCP server. Copy the production URL from the Shortcut developer docs. Dev-environment workspaces use https://dev.shortcutco.com/api/mcp instead.

name: klaviyo
description: Official Klaviyo MCP server. OAuth, so no API key is stored. A read-only toolset can be selected with documented query parameters.

name: next-devtools
description: Official Next.js devtools MCP bridge. Requires a running Next.js 16 or later dev server. The bridge discovers /_next/mcp on that server.

name: browser-use
description: Official Browser Use hosted MCP server. Requires a Browser Use API key sent as an Authorization bearer. Documented cost is model tokens plus 0.06 USD per browser-hour.

name: browserbase
description: Official Browserbase MCP. Tool calls require the API key as the browserbaseApiKey query parameter. The ${BROWSERBASE_API_KEY} placeholder is not a real key. Optional modelName and modelApiKey are only for non-default models and are not included. Mcp-Session-Id is a client transport header, not part of this template. Clients that open a new MCP session per call must reuse the Browserbase sessionId returned by start.

name: apify
description: Official Apify hosted MCP. OAuth is the recommended connection, and the documented config is this URL with no Authorization header. A bearer APIFY_TOKEN is an optional fallback that skips OAuth and is not preset. Local stdio is npx -y @apify/actors-mcp-server with APIFY_TOKEN. Actor runs are billed by Apify.

name: deepwiki
description: Official DeepWiki MCP server for public repository wikis. The docs describe it as free. Streamable HTTP is /mcp; the legacy SSE path is not used.

name: nuxt-ui
description: Official Nuxt UI remote MCP server for Nuxt UI documentation and component tools.

name: reference-filesystem
description: Reference implementation of a local filesystem MCP server from modelcontextprotocol/servers. Replace the directory argument with a directory you choose. The template starts read-only.

name: reference-sequential-thinking
description: Reference implementation of the sequential-thinking MCP server from modelcontextprotocol/servers. Requires Node.js 24 or newer when launched with npx. It is not a hosted product.

name: reference-fetch
description: Reference implementation of a web-fetch MCP server from modelcontextprotocol/servers. It refuses private and link-local addresses unless that guard is explicitly disabled. This template does not disable it. Requires Python 3.11.5 or newer via uvx.

name: reference-git
description: Reference implementation of a local Git MCP server from modelcontextprotocol/servers. Replace the repository path. It is not the official GitHub remote server. The project describes itself as early development.

name: reference-time
description: Reference implementation of a local time MCP server from modelcontextprotocol/servers. It is not a hosted product.

name: google-mcp-toolbox
description: Official Google MCP Toolbox server for databases. Point --config at a tools.yaml you create. Do not commit database passwords inside that file.

name: kubernetes-community
description: Community Kubernetes MCP server by Flux159, not a CNCF product. Starts with ALLOW_ONLY_READONLY_TOOLS=true. Uses the local kubeconfig. Do not enable the unauthenticated HTTP transport.

name: desktop-commander
description: Community Desktop Commander MCP server. It can run local shell commands and edit files. Install only if you accept that privilege. This is not a vendor-hosted server.

name: monday
description: Official monday.com platform MCP. Streamable HTTP. The documented client config sets Api-Version 2026-07 and does not preset Authorization. Compatible clients use OAuth 2.0. A personal API token bearer is only for clients that cannot do OAuth. SSE at /sse is deprecated. Tool calls count toward the daily API limit.

name: squarespace
description: Official Squarespace MCP. Domain tools do not need an account. Commerce tools require a Squarespace sign-in and, in the current docs, appear in Claude and ChatGPT. Commerce changes are live on the website.

name: steel
description: Official Steel browser MCP. Clients that support OAuth use this URL with no header and pick a project at sign-in. Clients that cannot sign in, including the documented Cursor example and Gemini CLI, must add Authorization Bearer ${STEEL_API_KEY}. Presetting that header skips OAuth.

name: upstash-redis
description: Official Upstash Redis MCP, separate from Context7. Copy UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN from the database REST API section. The token placeholder is empty. For TCP, set UPSTASH_REDIS_TCP_URL instead of the two REST variables.

name: intercom
description: Official Intercom MCP for the US region. OAuth. EU workspaces use https://mcp.eu.intercom.com/mcp. A bearer token is a fallback for clients that cannot do OAuth and is not preset. SSE paths are not this template.

name: semgrep
description: Official Semgrep multi-tenant MCP. OAuth is recommended. An Authorization bearer with a Semgrep app token is the fallback and is not preset. Read-only access is https://semgrep.dev/api/mcp/read-only. Single-tenant hosts replace the subdomain.

name: render
description: Official Render MCP. OAuth. An API key bearer is documented for non-interactive clients and is not preset, because it replaces the OAuth login.

name: twilio-docs
description: Official Twilio documentation MCP. No API key and no install. It searches Twilio docs and does not send messages or change a Twilio account.

name: replicate
description: Official local Replicate MCP from the documented npm config. Set REPLICATE_API_TOKEN locally. Replicate also documents a hosted server at https://mcp.replicate.com; this template is the local package.

name: sanity
description: Official Sanity MCP. OAuth by default. Token authentication is documented and is not preset.

name: resend
description: Official hosted Resend MCP. OAuth sign-in. No local process.

name: draw-io
description: Official hosted draw.io MCP. No install. The local npm package is a separate option and is not this template.

name: together-docs
description: Official Together AI documentation MCP. The documented HTTP install has no API key. It answers from Together docs and is not the inference API.

name: pinecone
description: Official Pinecone MCP. Set PINECONE_API_KEY locally. The empty value is a placeholder.

name: chroma
description: Official Chroma MCP in the documented ephemeral local mode. No API key. Persistent mode adds a data directory. Chroma Cloud needs the documented host, tenant, database, and API key and is not this template.

name: elevenlabs
description: Official ElevenLabs MCP. Set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY locally.

name: paypal
description: Official PayPal MCP npm server. The template uses the sandbox environment and the documented --tools=all flag. Set PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN locally. Production is a different environment value and can move live money.

name: xero
description: Official Xero MCP for a custom connection. Set XERO_CLIENT_ID and XERO_CLIENT_SECRET locally. Scopes are optional and default to the server's documented accounting scopes. These are env placeholders the server reads.

name: elasticsearch
description: Official Elastic Elasticsearch MCP over stdio. Set ES_URL and ES_API_KEY locally. The container is not published on a port. Basic auth is an alternative documented by Elastic and is not included.

name: netlify
description: Official Netlify MCP. It uses the Netlify login or OAuth connection. A personal access token is a documented troubleshooting fallback and is not stored here. Node.js 22 or newer is recommended.

name: railway
description: Official Railway MCP over HTTP so the client handles OAuth. The Railway CLI alternative is railway mcp, which proxies the same server over stdio. railway mcp local is a different in-process mode and is not this template.

name: motherduck
description: Official MotherDuck MCP in the documented read-only local DuckDB file mode. Replace the path. The in-memory example enables read-write and database switching and is not this template.

name: prefect
description: Official Prefect MCP for Prefect Cloud. Replace YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID and YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID in PREFECT_API_URL and set PREFECT_API_KEY locally. Self-hosted basic auth uses a different variable and is not included.

name: deepgram
description: Official Deepgram MCP. Install the deepgram-mcp command, then set DEEPGRAM_API_KEY locally. The documented client config uses that command rather than npx.

name: confluent
description: Official Confluent Cloud MCP. Run npx @confluentinc/mcp-confluent --init-config, put connection details in that file, and do not commit secrets. This template points --config at ./config.yaml.

name: buildkite
description: Official Buildkite remote MCP. OAuth is the recommended personal connection. A token-based server is documented separately and is not this URL.

name: contentful
description: Official Contentful MCP. Set the management token and space id locally. The template uses the master environment and api.contentful.com. Another region is a documented CONTENTFUL_HOST change.

name: appwrite
description: Official hosted Appwrite MCP. Browser consent, no API key in the template. https://mcp.appwrite.io/mcp reaches the same server. Older desktop clients in the README use a local mcp-remote proxy. This template is the remote URL.

name: langfuse-docs
description: Official Langfuse documentation MCP. The documented Claude install has no API key. It searches Langfuse docs and is not the Langfuse project API.

name: convex
description: Official Convex MCP. Requires Convex CLI login and a project so the agent can select a deployment.

name: gitbook
description: Official GitBook MCP. OAuth through the browser. A personal access token header is optional and not preset. Opening the URL in a browser is not the connection.

name: square
description: Official Square remote MCP, documented as beta. OAuth, no manual token. A local test instance is a separate option and is not this template.

name: planetscale
description: Official PlanetScale hosted MCP. OAuth is the default. Insights-only access without query execution is https://mcp.pscale.dev/mcp/planetscale-insights-only. A service token header is for clients that cannot do OAuth and is not preset.

name: hostinger
description: Official hosted Hostinger API MCP. OAuth. Setting HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN as an Authorization bearer bypasses OAuth and is not preset. The local server requires absolute node and script paths and is not this template.

name: snowflake
description: Official Snowflake-managed MCP URL pattern. Replace YOUR_ACCOUNT, YOUR_DATABASE, YOUR_SCHEMA, and YOUR_SERVER with the account hostname and the MCP server object you created. Account hostnames use hyphens, not underscores. This is not a public shared server. OAuth and the privileges in the Snowflake docs are required.

name: n8n
description: Official n8n instance MCP. Enable MCP access, then replace YOUR_N8N_HOST with the host from Settings, Instance-level MCP. The documented server URL ends in /mcp-server/http. OAuth is the recommended connection. This placeholder is not a live n8n host.

name: firebase
description: Official local Firebase MCP from firebase-tools. Sign in with the Firebase CLI. No API key is stored in this template.

name: calendly
description: Official Calendly scheduling MCP. OAuth. The docs-search server at https://developer.calendly.com/_mcp/server is a separate endpoint and is not this template.

name: circleci
description: Official hosted CircleCI MCP. OAuth2 is the documented connection. A personal API token is an alternative and is not preset. The older local npx server is deprecated and is not this template.

name: mailgun
description: Official Mailgun MCP. Set MAILGUN_API_KEY locally.

name: doppler
description: Official Doppler MCP. The documented config has no token. Run npx @dopplerhq/mcp-server login, or inject DOPPLER_TOKEN at runtime. Doppler recommends keeping that token out of the client config file.

name: inngest
description: Official Inngest Cloud MCP. OAuth is recommended. An API key is a fallback and is not preset. The local Dev Server at http://127.0.0.1:8288/mcp is not used here because remote catalog URLs must be https.

name: braintrust
description: Official Braintrust MCP for the US data plane. OAuth is recommended and needs no API key or OAuth client secret. EU is https://api-eu.braintrust.dev/mcp. A bearer API key is the fallback and is not preset. Bring-your-own-cloud uses the data-plane URL from Braintrust settings.

name: daytona
description: Official Daytona MCP command from the generated config: daytona-v0 mcp start. Run daytona-v0 login first. The vendor sample also sets HOME, PATH, and a macOS log path. Those machine-specific values are not copied here.

name: statsig
description: Official Statsig MCP. OAuth. The organization must allow personal console API keys for that flow. An API key through a local proxy is the fallback and is not preset.

name: 1password
description: Official 1Password Environments MCP. The desktop app provides the 1password-mcp command over stdio. The server does not return secret values to the client.

name: 21st-dev-magic
description: 21st.dev UI component MCP. The Magic package is a compatibility proxy; the documented client config is the hosted 21st HTTP server. An API key from 21st.dev/mcp is sent as x-api-key.

name: adobe
description: Adobe creativity connector for Acrobat, Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator, Firefly, Premiere, Express, InDesign, and Stock. The page lists the remote MCP URL and does not show request headers.

name: ahrefs
description: Official Ahrefs remote MCP for Lite plans and higher. Streamable HTTP. Connecting shows an authorization consent screen. No API key header is preset.

name: airbyte
description: Official Airbyte Cloud MCP. OAuth. The client connects to this URL and signs in through the browser. No API key is preset.

name: airtable
description: Airtable's MCP server lets an AI client read and change Airtable bases within the signed-in user's existing permissions. The support article points clients at https://mcp.airtable.com/mcp with OAuth.

name: aiven
description: Official Aiven MCP for PostgreSQL, Kafka, and other Aiven services. Remote OAuth at the hosted endpoint. A local npx mcp-aiven option also exists and takes AIVEN_TOKEN.

name: alchemy
description: Hosted Alchemy MCP for blockchain APIs and onchain data. Sign in with an Alchemy account. The README says @alchemy/mcp-server stops working on September 30, 2026.

name: algolia
description: Algolia Productivity MCP. Read-only, user-scoped search and analytics. Each user signs in; permissions follow the Algolia account. Enable it under Generative AI > MCP Servers > Productivity.

name: alibaba-cloud-ops
description: Alibaba Cloud Ops MCP for ECS, VPC, RDS, OSS, Cloud Monitor, and deployment. The same server can list a local directory and run a local shell script. Access keys are environment variables.

name: alibaba-devops
description: Alibaba Cloud Yunxiao DevOps MCP for organization, code, project, pipeline, package, and test tools. Central Streamable HTTP uses a personal access token. Stdio via npx alibabacloud-devops-mcp-server is the self-host alternative.

name: alpaca
description: Official Alpaca trading MCP. Requires Python 3.10+ and uv. ALPACA_PAPER_TRADE defaults to true; set it to false for live trading. The README says not to expose this server on the public internet.

name: anki
description: Community Anki MCP. Requires the Anki desktop app and the AnkiConnect plugin. The documented stdio config sets ANKI_CONNECT_URL to http://localhost:8765. HTTP and tunnel modes are separate.

name: antv-chart
description: AntV chart MCP. Generates charts through @antv/mcp-server-chart. Default transport is stdio. VIS_REQUEST_SERVER defaults to the AntV chart service.

name: apache-doris
description: Apache Doris read-only MCP. Install doris-mcp-server and point it at a Doris FE MySQL endpoint. Streamable HTTP in the quick start binds 127.0.0.1.

name: apollo-io
description: Official Apollo.io sales MCP for the authenticated user's workspace. Remote Streamable HTTP. No local runtime. Not Apollo GraphQL.

name: ashby
description: Ashby's MCP server lets an AI client query and update recruiting records the signed-in user can already see in Ashby. The docs include a Cursor config whose only server field is the HTTPS URL.

name: auth0
description: Official Auth0 MCP server, documented as beta. The manual client config runs npx @auth0/auth0-mcp-server run and completes Auth0 device authorization. No secret is stored in this template.

name: axiom
description: Official hosted Axiom MCP for APL and metrics queries. US endpoint shown here; EU is https://mcp.eu.axiom.co/mcp. The axiomhq/mcp-server-axiom repository is archived and tells readers not to use the local binary.

name: azure-devops
description: Official remote Azure DevOps MCP. Replace {organization} with the Azure DevOps organization name. https://mcp.dev.azure.com/ is the documented alternative when the organization is supplied on each tool call. The minimal mcp.json is this URL. Cursor and Claude Code need a separate Microsoft Entra app registration, which this template does not store.

name: blender
description: Community MCP for Blender. Client command is uvx mcp-for-blender. Install the addon with uvx mcp-for-blender install-addon and enable Interface: MCP for Blender. The addon server starts when Blender opens.

name: booking
description: Booking.com Demand API MCP for approved partners. Fixed endpoint with a trailing slash. Send the affiliate ID and Demand API key as x-booking-affiliate-id and x-booking-authorization, without a Bearer prefix.

name: brex
description: Brex MCP for expenses, users, cards, banking, bills, and travel. Beta. An account admin enables it. API-token bearer auth is documented for clients that cannot use OAuth.

name: bright-data
description: Bright Data hosted MCP for search, scraping, browser automation, and business search. Token comes from the Bright Data account settings. Local npx @brightdata/mcp with API_TOKEN is the other documented option.

name: buddy
description: Buddy remote MCP for pipelines, deployments, sandboxes, packages, and domains. The sample uses the US URL. Europe is https://mcp.eu.buddy.works/mcp and Asia is https://mcp.asia.buddy.works/mcp.

name: cal-com
description: Cal.com MCP for bookings and event types. Requires a Cal.com API key. The project warning says it is in active development. --all-tools is optional and not included.

name: clerk
description: Official Clerk MCP. OAuth. Clients that cannot complete browser sign-in can use npx mcp-remote against the same URL. This template is the remote URL with no header.

name: coingecko
description: CoinGecko MCP for prices, markets, and onchain data. The free remote server needs no API key. https://mcp.pro-api.coingecko.com/mcp uses a CoinGecko API key through the browser flow. Local server is npx -y @coingecko/coingecko-mcp.

name: couchbase
description: Official Couchbase operational MCP. Requires a cluster such as Capella. Password or client certificate authenticates. The operational-insights subcommand is a second server and is not this template.

name: crowdstrike
description: CrowdStrike Falcon MCP. uvx falcon-mcp talks to the Falcon API. Documented base URL is https://api.crowdstrike.com. The editor sample also accepts --env-file /path/to/.env.

name: dbt
description: Official dbt platform remote MCP, documented as public beta for Starter, Enterprise, and Enterprise+ accounts. Replace YOUR_DBT_HOST_URL. OAuth uses this URL only and does not put a client id or secret in the client JSON.

name: deepl
description: DeepL hosted MCP for translation, rewrite, documents, glossaries, and style rules. OAuth with the DeepL account. Plans include DeepL Free and seat-based plans.

name: devcycle
description: DevCycle hosted MCP for feature flags, variables, and targeting. No local install for the hosted server. The Claude Desktop sample wraps the same URL with npx mcp-remote.

name: docling
description: Docling MCP for document conversion and generation. The client snippet does not set a service URL. Remote mode uses DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_URL and DOCLING_MCP_SERVICE_API_KEY. Local mode installs docling-mcp[local].

name: excalidraw
description: Excalidraw MCP app server for hand-drawn diagrams in clients that support MCP Apps. The hosted URL is given without an extra path. Self-hosted Vercel deploys use /mcp on the project host.

name: expo
description: Official Expo MCP for Expo and React Native docs, builds, and project tools. OAuth at this URL.

name: fireflies
description: The Fireflies MCP server lets an AI tool ask questions about meeting transcripts, summaries, and action items in the connected Fireflies account. The remote URL is https://api.fireflies.ai/mcp over streamable HTTP.

name: firefox-devtools
description: Mozilla Firefox MCP for agent browsing and DevTools inspection. The config-file example adds --headless and a viewport. Requires Firefox 100+ and Node.js 20.19 or newer.

name: gamma
description: Gamma hosted MCP for generating, reading, editing, and exporting presentations and documents. Clients that support OAuth dynamic client registration use https://mcp.gamma.app/mcp. A custom client registers redirect URIs first. REST API keys are a separate interface.

name: gitkraken
description: GitKraken MCP from the GitKraken CLI. Provides git, GitHub, GitLab, Jira, and Azure DevOps tools. Install the gk CLI, then run gk mcp. Authenticate with gk.

name: gitmcp
description: Community GitMCP remote documentation server. Replace {owner} and {repo} with a GitHub project. The README also documents https://gitmcp.io/docs for any repository on demand.

name: globalping
description: jsDelivr Globalping MCP for network measurements. Streamable HTTP. OAuth is handled in interactive clients. An API token can be sent as Authorization bearer instead.

name: google-bigquery
description: Official remote BigQuery MCP. Enable the BigQuery API. Authenticate with Google Cloud credentials or OAuth. This template stores the documented endpoint and does not store an OAuth client id or secret.

name: incident-io
description: incident.io's remote MCP server lets an AI client query incidents, alerts, and on-call data for the signed-in user. The setup page's direct client examples use https://mcp.incident.io/mcp. The older incidentio-mcp-golang repository is archived and points here.

name: launchdarkly
description: Official LaunchDarkly hosted MCP server. OAuth. Federal and EU instances should use LaunchDarkly's local server instead of this URL.

name: lucid
description: Lucid's hosted MCP server lets an AI client search, summarize, edit, and create Lucid documents the user can access. The README lists streamable HTTP at https://mcp.lucid.app/mcp and OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration.

name: mailchimp
description: Official Mailchimp Transactional MCP. Send the Transactional API key as an Authorization bearer. The ${MAILCHIMP_API_KEY} placeholder is not a real key.

name: obsidian
description: Community Obsidian MCP for a vault exposed by the Local REST API plugin. Set OBSIDIAN_API_KEY. The server defaults OBSIDIAN_HOST to 127.0.0.1 and OBSIDIAN_PORT to 27124 when those variables are omitted.

name: snyk
description: Official local Snyk MCP through the Snyk CLI. Requires an authenticated snyk binary on PATH. The Studio installer may record that binary's absolute path instead of this command. Snyk does not publish a hosted scanning URL.

name: zoominfo
description: ZoomInfo's MCP server lets an AI client find companies and contacts, enrich records, and research accounts within the user's ZoomInfo license. The Cursor example is a URL-only entry for https://mcp.zoominfo.com/mcp followed by OAuth.

name: growthbook
description: Official GrowthBook hosted MCP. The first tool call opens a GrowthBook sign-in. Self-hosted GrowthBook uses a different manual configuration and is not this template.

name: lovable
description: Official Lovable MCP. OAuth. Clients that complete login on localhost register automatically. No API key is preset.

name: plane
description: Official hosted Plane MCP. OAuth on connect, so no API key is stored. The API-key HTTP path and the local uvx server are separate options and are not this template.

name: postman
description: Official Postman remote MCP in the documented default Minimal mode. OAuth, so no API key header is set. Code mode is /code and Full mode is /mcp on the same host. EU and the local npx server use an API key instead and are not this template.

name: tableau
description: Official hosted Tableau MCP for Tableau Cloud. OAuth 2.1. Tableau Server and self-hosted installs use a different command and are not this template.

name: todoist
description: Official Todoist remote MCP. Streamable HTTP with OAuth. The local npx @todoist/mcp package is a separate option and is not this template.

name: wix
description: Official Wix remote MCP. The documented client config is this HTTP URL. The legacy SSE path and the local @wix/mcp-remote bridge are not this template.
